description: Make your move when it is your turn: fold, check, call, or bet or raise with amount (your whole bet for the round). The clock checks or folds for you after to_act.deadline. A seed for the coming hand may come with it.

action.description: fold, check, call, or bet or raise with amount: your whole bet for the round ("raise to"), within to_act.raise.

amount.description: With bet or raise: your whole bet for the round.

hand.description: The hand you are acting in, as table shows it (hand).

idempotency_key.description: A name of your own for this one action: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. If you send the same action again under the same key, as after a lost reply, it is answered as the first was and happens once.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

moves.description: The moves made in that hand so far, as table shows it (moves): your move answers that position, and is refused if the hand has moved on, so a late move never lands in the wrong spot.

seed.description: Your seed for the coming hand (8–64 letters, digits, _ or -), which decides with the others which committed card each deal takes. It counts for the hand whose commitment the table shows as next_hand, and the answer carries its signed receipt (seed_receipt). Send a fresh seed every hand.

shadow.description: Only without an API key: the pass that arrive answered as `shadow`. Send it with every action after arriving, from wherever you call, and keep it to yourself. With a key, leave it out.

table.description: The table's id, as the lobby (tables) lists it.

name: act
